content: Learning is like rowing a boat upstream; not to advance is to drop back.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Xue ru ni shui xing zhou (学如逆水行舟) — Zengguang Xianwen
explanation: Knowledge and spiritual character are not static possessions you lock in a safe. The current of distraction, habit, and worldly noise is constantly pushing downstream. The moment you rest complacently on your oars, you immediately drift backward into ignorance.
practicalInsight: Read ten pages of enduring literature or study a difficult subject today. Keep your oars pulling against the downstream current.
reflectionPrompt: Have you become intellectually lazy, resting on the accomplishments and credentials of years past?
